Solve mysterious puzzles, overcome obstacles, and embark on an unforgettable adventure with your friend. 🗝️🤝

notes.title: Together in Forgotten Lands now has a PlayStation page! 🎮✨
notes.content:
📢 Hey puzzle lovers!

Together in Forgotten Lands now has a PlayStation page! 🎮✨


This co-op puzzle adventure, which we have been passionately developing for a year, is now also playable on PlayStation.


You can support us by adding it to your wishlist on PlayStation 👉🏻👈🏻


Playstation Page


Improvements for our Steam community will continue without pause. Your support means the world to us! 💙

notes.title: 📌 Name Update
notes.content:
📌 Name Update

To prevent any potential copyright issues, we’ve renamed the game from “Together in Forgotten Realms” to Together in Forgotten Lands.

Same excitement, new name — the journey continues! 🎮💫

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508501/87f86d48df078300dcfbb2f3734937f678f75478.png
